generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Node.js (22+) RS274-style G-code simulator in `output/` with CLI entrypoint `output/main.js`.

- Run: `node output/main.js --input <gcode_file> --output <result_file>`
- Supports optional: `--tool-table`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--parameter-input`, `--parameter-output`, `--probe-box`, `--probe-tool`, `--trace-output` plus exactly one of `--trace-time-step|--trace-distance-step|--trace-position-tolerance`.
- Writes `--output` JSON on both success and error; writes `--trace-output` JSON on both success and error (when enabled); writes `--parameter-output` only on success.

Key files:
- `output/main.js`: argument parsing, file I/O, exit codes
- `output/simulator.js`: execution engine + trace emission
- `output/gcode_parser.js`, `output/expression.js`: parsing + expression evaluation
- `output/trace.js`: trace delta formatting rules
- `output/parameter_file.js`, `output/tool_table.js`: RS274 file formats

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
